```{r}
# install.packages(c("readxl", "dplyr", "tidyr", "stringr", "jsonlite"))
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(jsonlite)
file_path <- choose.files()
df2 <- read_excel(file_path)


threshold_score <- 5

df_processed <- df2 %>%

  mutate(
    score_a = as.numeric(str_extract(result, "^[0-9]+")),
    score_b = as.numeric(str_extract(result, "[0-9]+$"))
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    chosen_score = pmax(score_a, score_b, na.rm = TRUE),
    chosen_answer = case_when(
      score_a >= score_b ~ answer1,
      TRUE ~ answer2
    )
  ) %>%

  filter(chosen_score >= threshold_score) %>%

  drop_na(Scenario, Masked_Question, chosen_answer)




format_to_chatml <- function(scenario, question, answer) {
  system_prompt <- paste("You are a professional and highly intuitive AI customer service assistant specialized in the domain of:", scenario)
  

  list(
    messages = list(
      list(role = "system", content = system_prompt),
      list(role = "user", content = question),
      list(role = "assistant", content = answer)
    )
  )
}


sft_list <- lapply(1:nrow(df_processed), function(i) {
  format_to_chatml(
    scenario = df_processed$Scenario[i],
    question = df_processed$Masked_Question[i],
    answer = df_processed$chosen_answer[i]
  )
})


output_file <- choose.files()


json_lines <- sapply(sft_list, function(x) {
  toJSON(x, auto_unbox = TRUE, force = TRUE)
})


writeLines(json_lines, output_file, useBytes = TRUE)



input_file <- choose.files()
output_file <- choose.files()


all_lines <- readLines(input_file, warn = FALSE)


total_count <- length(all_lines)

set.seed(2026)


sample_size <- 169

sampled_lines <- sample(all_lines, size = sample_size)


writeLines(sampled_lines, output_file)



# install.packages("jsonlite")
library(jsonlite)

file_169 <- choose.files()
file_1331 <- choose.files()
output_file <- choose.files()



lines_169 <- readLines(file_169, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
lines_1331 <- readLines(file_1331, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")


formatted_169 <- lapply(lines_169, function(line) {

  parsed <- fromJSON(line, simplifyVector = FALSE)
  

  new_messages <- lapply(parsed$messages, function(msg) {

    new_role <- switch(msg$role,
                       "human" = "user",
                       "gpt" = "assistant",
                       msg$role) 
    

    list(role = new_role, content = msg$value)
  })
  

  list(messages = new_messages)
})


parsed_1331 <- lapply(lines_1331, function(line) {
  fromJSON(line, simplifyVector = FALSE)
})


combined_list <- c(parsed_1331, formatted_169)


set.seed(2026)
combined_list <- combined_list[sample(length(combined_list))]


out_con <- file(output_file, open = "w", encoding = "UTF-8")

for (item in combined_list) {

  json_str <- toJSON(item, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  writeLines(json_str, out_con)
}

close(out_con)


```
